description: There's a Visor On My Face (TVOMF): a motion HUD for Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.2 and 26.3 on Fabric. Your HUD sways, bobs and curves like it's drawn on a helmet visor (HUD sway, curved HUD). Client-side. Based on GD656MotionHUD by Minecraft_GD656.

mods.name: There's a Visor On My Face
mods.description: Your HUD sways, bobs and curves as if it were drawn on a helmet visor. Based on GD656MotionHUD by Minecraft_GD656 (Forge 1.20.1, MIT), whose HUD sway this mod ports to Fabric and builds on. Not affiliated with or supported by the original author.

releases.notes:
**First beta for Minecraft 1.21.11.** Every feature of the 26.2 release: sway, bob, vertical sway, the curved HUD (sphere and cylinder), sprint curve and zoom, per-element offsets, and sway for 3D models on the HUD.

This is the same code as 0.1.1-alpha.4 with the version label changed. It is called a beta because it has now passed the project's full test checklist; the list and the complete record of who tested what, on which build, are in [BETA-CHECKLIST.md](https://github.com/irfanadli97/tvomf/blob/main/BETA-CHECKLIST.md).

**Tested by script**
- Build, hooks and the visual test, with the mod alone and with five sets of other mods, on Java 25 and on Java 21.
- 27 settings-file checks (missing, renamed, cut-off, out-of-range and mistyped files).

**Played by hand**
- With Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Entity Culling, ImmediatelyFast, Mod Menu and Cloth Config, without and with Iris and shaders.
- With Xaero's Minimap, Jade, AppleSkin, JEI and Simple Voice Chat.
- With BedrockIfy, Raised, Scoreboard Overhaul, Chat Animation, Smooth GUI and Inventory Profiles Next.
- A single 2 hour 30 minute session online with 29 mods loaded: no crash, a clean log, and the HUD and frame rate the same at the end as at the start.

**Found and fixed during testing:** seams in the spyglass view while it opened, the F3 screen bending, and a start-up crash on a mistyped settings file.

**Known limits**
- All hand play was on Java 25; Java 21 has been covered by scripted runs only.
- Moving the chat with this mod's own offsets does not move where it responds to clicks. Raised does that properly.

**Needs:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API, Java 21 or newer. Client-side only; works on any server. Mod Menu and Cloth Config are optional, for the settings screen.

**Install:** put `tvomf-0.1.1-beta.1+1.21.11-fabric.jar` in your `mods` folder and remove any older TVOMF jar.

Based on [GD656MotionHUD](https://modrinth.com/mod/gd656motionhud) by Minecraft_GD656 (Forge 1.20.1, MIT). Unofficial; please report problems here, not to the original author. The README's AI disclosure applies to this release.

**Alpha for Minecraft 1.21.11**, replacing 0.1.1-alpha.3. Same fix as 0.1.3 for 26.2.

**Fixed**
- **Start-up crash:** a `config/tvomf.json` with text where a number belongs (for example `"maxOffset": "lots"`) stopped the game from starting. Any unreadable settings file now falls back to the defaults instead.

**Changed**
- An unreadable settings file is kept as `tvomf.json.broken` before a fresh one is written.
- Values outside their documented ranges in the file are pulled to the nearest end of the range, and the log says which.
- An offset for a HUD element id that does not exist is reported in the log.

**Checked by script:** 27 settings-file checks, a real start-up with the file that used to crash, and the visual test with the mod alone and with five sets of other mods (the common rendering mods, the same with Iris and shaders, the common HUD mods including Xaero's Minimap and JourneyMap, a set of less common HUD mods, and all of them together).

**Played by hand:** on the previous alpha, which differs only in how the settings file is read: the rendering set without and with Iris and shaders, and the HUD set (Xaero's Minimap, Jade, AppleSkin, JEI, Simple Voice Chat).

**Not checked:** hand play with the less common HUD mods, a long session, and Java 21 (all testing so far ran on Java 25; the jar is compiled for Java 21). Please report anything odd in the issues.

**Needs:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer, Fabric API, Java 21 or newer. Client-side only. Mod Menu and Cloth Config are optional.

**Install:** put `tvomf-0.1.1-alpha.4+1.21.11-fabric.jar` in your `mods` folder and remove any older TVOMF jar.

**Not checked:** hand play with the HUD mods and the less common ones, a long session, and Java 21 (all testing so far ran on Java 25; the jar is compiled for Java 21). Please report anything odd in the issues.
